name: Evergreen anytime / partial-period proration (monthly, mid-month cancel)
expected: An Evergreen monthly line with AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true + a non-null itemTransientEndDate routes through V21 step 47 (Evergreen anytime proration filter, Line level) -> ListOperation83 gate -> native Proration BKM (EffectiveFrom..EffectiveTo=itemTransientEndDate, ProrationPeriod=PricingTermUnit) -> ProrationMultiplier stamped to PricingTermCount -> SubscriptionPricing applies the fraction. E.g. cancel day 15 of a 30-day month on a 4000 GBP line -> ~0.5 multiplier -> 2000 refund; order start 1/15 monthly -> first month prorated.
actual: UNTESTABLE on real UAT data. The Evergreen branch is correctly wired in V21 (verified in live proc dump Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/v21_fresh.json: versionNumber=21; step idx47 'EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel' ListGroup -> child ListOperation83 AdvancedListFilter with conditionLogic '1 AND 2 AND 3' = SellingModelType Equals 'Evergreen' AND AllowPartialProrationPeriods Equals true AND itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull -> child Proration BKM actionType=Proration, EffectiveTo bound to itemTransientEndDate, output ProrationMultiplier->PricingTermCount -> child SubscriptionPricing). BUT the FortraUAT catalog contains ZERO Evergreen-sellable data: ProductSellingModelOption GROUP BY SellingModelType = TermDefined 4944 / OneTime 3939 / Evergreen 0; PricebookEntry WHERE SellingModelType='Evergreen' = 0; QuoteLineItem WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (Evergreen models) = 0; QuoteLineItem GROUP BY SellingModelType = {null 58451, TermDefined 938923, OneTime 226476} (no Evergreen); Asset WHERE Evergreen = none. The four Evergreen ProductSellingModels (Monthly 0jPWC00000006C92AI, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Yearly) exist as shells with 0 options. No 'Alert Logic' product exists (Product2 LIKE '%Alert Logic%' = 0). Gate criterion 1 (SellingModelType='Evergreen') fails for every line in the org, so step 47 can never fire; the mid-month-cancel half also has no contracted Evergreen source asset.
evidence: Live proc dump Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/v21_fresh.json idx47/78/99 (ListOperation83 gate + Proration BKM). SOQL: 'SELECT ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType,COUNT(Id) FROM ProductSellingModelOption GROUP BY ...' -> TermDefined 4944, OneTime 3939, Evergreen 0. 'SELECT COUNT() FROM PricebookEntry WHERE ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType=Evergreen' -> 0. 'SELECT COUNT() FROM QuoteLineItem WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (SELECT Id FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE SellingModelType=Evergreen)' -> 0. B-08 OneTime control quote 0Q0WC000003FN970AG lines are all SMT OneTime/TermDefined (correctly excluded from this branch).
proposedFix: Not a defect. The Evergreen anytime proration branch (V21 step 47 / ListOperation83 / Proration BKM) is correctly gated and wired but is dead-code in FortraUAT because no product is configured on any Evergreen ProductSellingModel (0 PSMOs, 0 PBEs, 0 lines, 0 assets) and itemTransientEndDate is a native transient context field that only populates on a cancel/amend of an Evergreen contracted line. To make I-04 testable a catalog/config owner would need to (1) add a ProductSellingModelOption binding a real product (e.g. an Alert Logic MDR SKU) to 'Evergreen - Monthly' (0jPWC00000006C92AI) with AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true, (2) create an active Evergreen PBE in the Fortra Price Book with a correct non-zero GBP/USD list, then (3) order+contract it and issue a mid-month cancel so RLM populates itemTransientEndDate natively. Hand-fabricating this via fixture + DML is rejected here: itemTransientEndDate is not a stored DML-settable field, and there is NO real UI-priced Evergreen record anywhere in the org to serve as a positive control, so a hand-built Evergreen line would be the headless base-seed-gap trap (BLOCKED, not FAIL) per the method brief.
notes: defect_provenance=none/catalog-derived. V21 active confirmed (versionNumber=21, design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY). Branch trace: step 47 'Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level)' is the SOLE Evergreen group and the ONLY Proration BKM in V21 (EffectiveTo=itemTransientEndDate); the term-defined PTC writer that I-01/I-02 validated is a SEPARATE mechanism (no 'Term-Defined proration filter' group label appears in the V21 dump - it is implemented elsewhere). Distinction from siblings: I-01/I-02/I-03 = TermDefined PTC/EndDate (real data exists, PASS); I-04 = Evergreen partial-period (no catalog data). This is an org-config observation worth flagging to the catalog team (Evergreen branch unexercisable) but is NOT a PROCEDURE-DEFECT or ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT per the taxonomy - the procedure logic is sound; nothing mis-prices because nothing can route here. preflight=fail: cannot satisfy product-SellingModelType / Evergreen-PBE / source-asset-net preconditions -> verdict BLOCKED (data unverified), never FAIL, per method-brief gate.
verdict_reason: The V21 Evergreen anytime proration branch (step 47 ListOperation83 gate: SellingModelType='Evergreen' AND AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true AND itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull) is correctly wired, but FortraUAT has zero Evergreen catalog data (0 PSMOs, 0 PBEs, 0 lines, 0 assets), so the branch is unreachable on real data and no valid fixture/positive-control can be built without hand-fabricating the entire Evergreen catalog plus a transient context field -> preflight fails -> BLOCKED.
